PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED:

2019-02-25 | 1092 m MD | Tipam | cementing_issue | low | 2.0 hrs NPT
Cause: Poor cement bond / losses during primary cementing of casing shoe in Tipam.
Remedy: Squeeze cemented shoe track, pressure tested to spec before drilling out.

2019-02-26 | 1982 m MD | Barail | cementing_issue | low | 1.8 hrs NPT
Cause: Poor cement bond / losses during primary cementing of casing shoe in Barail.
Remedy: Squeeze cemented shoe track, pressure tested to spec before drilling out.

2019-02-26 | 2044 m MD | Barail | mud_loss | medium | 3.1 hrs NPT
Cause: Lost circulation 43 bbl/hr while drilling Barail sand, partial returns only.
Remedy: Pumped 55 bbl LCM pill, reduced ROP, regained partial returns.

2019-02-27 | 2112 m MD | Barail | stuck_pipe | critical | 22.4 hrs NPT
Cause: Pipe stuck while tripping through Barail, unable to work free, torque and drag increasing prior to stick
Remedy: Worked pipe with max overpull, spotted 105 bbl pipe-lax pill, freed after 22.4 hrs.

2019-03-01 | 2791 m MD | Kopili | overpressure | critical | 20.0 hrs NPT
Cause: SPP trend increasing and drag rising while drilling into Kopili, suspected transition zone.
Remedy: Raised mud weight in 24-ppg steps, monitored trip gas, continued drilling with caution.

2019-03-02 | 2876 m MD | Kopili | kick | critical | 20.2 hrs NPT
Cause: Flow-check positive, pit gain of 76 bbl and flow-out exceeding flow-in while in Kopili.
Remedy: Shut in well, closed BOP, circulated kill mud per driller's method.

2019-03-02 | 2906 m MD | Kopili | overpressure | medium | 4.2 hrs NPT
Cause: Well kicked back while circulating out of Kopili, gas readings elevated on trip gas.
Remedy: Weighted mud up to balance formation pressure, circulated bottoms up before resuming.

2019-03-03 | 3113 m MD | Sylhet | mud_loss | medium | 1.4 hrs NPT
Cause: Lost circulation 79 bbl/hr while drilling Sylhet sand, partial returns only.
Remedy: Pumped 36 bbl LCM pill, reduced ROP, regained partial returns.

2019-03-03 | 3180 m MD | Basement | torque_spike | medium | 3.9 hrs NPT
Cause: Sharp torque increase on contact with Basement, ROP dropped to near zero.
Remedy: Reduced WOB and RPM, reamed interval, resumed drilling at reduced parameters.
